title: Israel assassinating Nazi rocket scientists in Egypt via the Gehlen organization

tellings.quote: Israel was assassinating Nazi scotet scientists in Egypt that were developing you know rocket weapons for the Egyptian military but leveraging you know the Gellen organization I believe

plain: Israel once assassinated former Nazi scientists working in Egypt on rocket weapons for the Egyptian military, and did it using the Gehlen organisation, the spy network run by the former German intelligence chief Reinhard Gehlen, says Matthew Brown, a former Defense Department official. He tells Michels this from memory, hedging with "I believe", and names no source. He raises it as an example of how intelligence services quietly used old Nazi networks.
